normalize: <image1> shows a creature. Clean up the drawing style: remove all dark outlines and line art so every shape is a flat filled area; the darker shade on the right side of the body becomes a darker apricot orange instead of green or olive; the three gill fronds on each side of the head become soft, rounded, flat coral fronds with a few rounded scallops instead of thin hairy strands. Keep the face, the smile, the cheeks, the pose, the cream belly stripe and the colors exactly the same. Plain flat pale mint background.
evolve: <image1> shows a creature. Draw the same creature at its next, more grown-up stage. The whole silhouette changes: {change} Keep the face, the coral cheeks, the three soft coral gill fronds on each side of the head, the cream belly stripe from chin to tail tip and the flat style without outlines; the body is light warm apricot (#FFC56E), not orange. Fins and wings are coral, never turquoise or green. No teeth, no claws. Full body, plain flat pale mint background.
mood: <image1> shows a creature. Change only its facial expression and the pose of its arms or front fins: {mood}. Keep the body shape, the pose, all colors, the gill fronds and the flat two-tone style without outlines exactly the same. Plain flat pale mint background.
mood_no_limbs: It has no arms and no legs; it shows its feelings only with its face, its gill fronds and its tail.
accessory: <image1> shows a creature. Add {items}. The accessories never cover the eyes, mouth or cheeks and use the same flat two-tone style without outlines, light from the upper left. Keep the creature, its pose and its colors exactly the same. Plain flat pale mint background.

fixes.shade: <image1> shows a creature. Recolor only the shading: the olive green area on the right side of the tail becomes a slightly darker apricot orange, so the whole body has exactly two tones, warm apricot (#FFC56E) and one slightly darker apricot shade, plus the light cream belly stripe. Keep the shapes, the face, the coral gill fronds and everything else exactly the same. Plain flat pale mint background.
fixes.color: <image1> shows a creature. Recolor only: the orange body becomes a lighter, warm apricot yellow (#FFC56E) with one slightly darker apricot shade on the right side; the belly stays light cream (#FFEBC4) and the gill fronds stay coral. Remove the shadow on the ground. Keep all shapes, the pose and the face exactly the same. Plain flat pale mint background.
fixes.flat: <image1> shows a round jelly egg with a tiny sleeping creature inside. Redraw it in a strictly flat style: the egg is one flat pale cream circle with one slightly darker cream shade on its right side and one small white highlight at the upper left, with no bubbles, no texture and no outline; remove the shadow under it; the tiny curled-up creature inside becomes warm apricot (#FFC56E) with coral gill fronds and closed sleeping eyes. Plain flat pale mint background.

f1.name: Kaulquappe
f1.body_plan: großer runder Kopf, kurzer Flossenschwanz, keine Beine; schwebt

f2.name: Hüpfer
f2.body_plan: sitzt auf zwei Hinterbeinchen, winzige Ärmchen, Schwanz um die Füße
f2.change: it no longer floats; it sits upright on the ground on two small sturdy hind legs like a little frog, two tiny front arms appear, and the longer tail with a soft coral fin seam curls around its feet.

f3.name: Krabbler
f3.body_plan: lang und flach auf vier kurzen Beinen, waagerecht wie ein junger Axolotl
f3.change: the body becomes long and low; it walks horizontally on four short legs like a young axolotl crawling, seen from the side in three-quarter view, the head still big, the long tail with its coral fin seam trailing behind.

f4.name: Aufrechter
f4.body_plan: steht aufrecht wie ein Otter, Paddelflossen vor der Brust, Schwanz am Boden
f4.change: it stands up: the whole body is now vertical and taller than wide, rearing up tall on its tail in a playful upright S-curve like an otter standing on its hind legs, with a clear slender neck; the head becomes much smaller in relation to the body; the front legs become small paddle flippers held in front of the chest; the tail curls on the ground behind it.

f5.name: Springer
f5.body_plan: C-Bogen wie ein springender Delfin, lange Korallenflossen, Rückensaum, Schwanzfluke
f5.change: it leaps in a big round arc like a dolphin jumping, the long body curved like the letter C; the paddle flippers become long rounded coral fins; a low soft coral fin ridge grows along the whole back; the tail ends in a wide soft fluke.

f6.name: Spirale
f6.body_plan: rollt sich zur aufrechten Spirale, Flossenkamm, Flossenflügel
f6.change: the body grows twice as long and coils into a loose upright spiral like a seahorse; a frilly coral fin crest runs along the entire back; the front fins become long flowing fin-wings.

f7.name: Flügling
f7.body_plan: schwebt unter zwei breiten Flügelpaaren, Schwanz hängt in einer Welle
f7.change: it rises into the air: the fin-wings grow into two pairs of wide, soft, rounded coral wings spread to both sides; the long body hangs upright below the wings and the tail hangs down in one gentle wave.

f8a.name: Drache, fliegend
f8a.body_plan: fliegt, Körper zum Ring geschlungen, spitze Flügel nach oben, Kiemenkrone
f8a.change: it becomes a majestic lagoon dragon flying in the air: the long body curls into one round loop like a ring, the two pairs of wings spread up and back, the gill fronds have grown into a soft coral crown; the silhouette is compact, about as wide as tall, and the head is big enough that the face stays clear.

f8b.name: Drache, sitzend
f8b.body_plan: sitzt wie eine Katze, Flügelfächer hinter dem Rücken, Schwanz um die Füße, Kiemenkrone
f8b.change: it becomes a majestic, calm lagoon dragon sitting upright and proud like a cat; the two pairs of wings are folded up high behind its back like a soft fan; the gill fronds have grown into a soft coral crown; the long tail wraps around its front feet; the silhouette is compact, about as wide as tall.

freut.name: freut sich
freut.prompt: happy: closed laughing eyes curved upward like ^ ^, an open smiling mouth, the arms or front fins raised up in joy
freut.prompt_no_limbs: happy: closed laughing eyes curved upward like ^ ^, an open smiling mouth, the gill fronds raised up and the tail swishing in joy

neugierig.name: neugierig

doest.name: döst

schlaeft.name: schläft
schlaeft.prompt: fast asleep: eyes closed, the body curled up a little, and a small pale yellow crescent moon above the head; peaceful and content, not sad

Centered with generous margin on a plain flat pale mint background (#DDF0EE), no ground, no shadow, no text.
t2i.egg-b: A single round lagoon egg like a frog-spawn ball: a large, clear, pale cream jelly sphere drawn with flat shapes, and inside it a tiny apricot tadpole with coral gill fronds curled up asleep. Flat 2D, no outlines, two-tone shading with light from the upper left, no gradients, no texture. Centered on a plain flat pale mint background (#DDF0EE), no ground, no shadow, no text.
t2i.acc-sheet: A sticker sheet of twelve small accessories for a cute lagoon creature, arranged in a neat grid of four columns and three rows with space between them, each item alone: a tiny round straw hat, a coral starfish hair clip, a hibiscus flower, a small water-lily-leaf hat, a little flower crown, a hair bow; a seashell necklace, a neckerchief, a flower lei garland, a bow tie, a pearl necklace, a knitted scarf. Flat 2D shapes, no outlines, two-tone shading with light from the upper left, soft rounded friendly forms, palette of cream, apricot, coral, sand, leaf green and deep lagoon teal. Plain flat pale mint background, no text.
